evidence: The cold-target text result is mixed but partly positive: ensemble macro 0.3081 → **0.3201**, micro 0.3762 → 0.3717
observation: Adding text-similar targets as an extra neighbour source for cold-target factor smoothing was compared with PPI/ligand/GO smoothing at beta 1.0. It raised macro AUPRC at both component counts but lowered micro, so it was recorded as a conditional, macro-oriented adapter rather than a primary model.
subject: F-82
title: Text-similar target borrowing is a macro-only cold-target gain
